title.narrative: ''Southern and Eastern Mediterranean Regional Green Economy Financing Facility - SEMED Regional GEFF”

description.narrative: The SEMED Regional GEFF is designed to provide credit lines to Participating Financeial Institutions (the PFIs) in the Target Countries for on-lending to private sector borrowers and households. The programme aims to systematically address market barriers and entrenched behaviour that hinder the uptake of green technologies and solutions in the local market, and hence will contribute to building a green, climate-resilient and competitive economy in the Target Countries.

comment.narrative: CO2 eq ktonsyr

According to the presentation of the SEMED Regional GEFF 2nd Steering Committee meeting on 28 June 2022 no budget has been utilised for financial incentives till the reporting period but only for the Technical Assistance services. An account of country wise progress as of the reporting period is given below. In Jordan negotiations are ongoing with three Partner Financial Institutions for potential pipeline of projects with signings expected in July 2022. In Tunisia discussions with ATL Leasing company and Enda MFI including presentations of the Programme were made by Consultants. They showed strong interest to participate but projects were put on hold due to the slow economic recovery. While in Lebanon procurement of Project Consultant was cancelled and no EU NIP funds were utilised as of yet due to the uncertain situation.Therefore there has been no intervention induced impact on Greenhouse gas emissions as of yet.

comment.narrative: According to the presentation of the SEMED Regional GEFF 2nd Steering Committee meeting on 28 June 2022 no budget has been utilised for financial incentives till the reporting period but only for the Technical Assistance services. An account of country wise progress as of the reporting period is given below. In Jordan negotiations are ongoing with three Partner Financial Institutions for potential pipeline of projects with signings expected in July 2022. In Tunisia discussions with ATL Leasing company and Enda MFI including presentations of the Programme were made by Consultants. They showed strong interest to participate but projects were put on hold due to the slow economic recovery. While in Lebanon procurement of Project Consultant was cancelled and no EU NIP funds were utilised as of yet due to the uncertain situation.
